name: Emergency Crops!
tagline: A farming game about financial literacy: crops need emergency funds when things go wrong.
problem: Students learn money decisions through costly trial and error.
solution: A Unity WebGL game where money, risk and stability are shown through farming events, with AI voice.
demo_moment: Team-described: weather a crisis with your emergency fund.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 176 submissions.
Turns an abstract concept into game state.

lessons: Make the abstract lesson the game's resource.
